target: daily sea-ice concentration fraction, Antarctic grid
validation_scope: Chronological holdout from the test dataset released with the Antarctic ConvLSTM paper. It is held out from this baseline fit but is not an independent external-product evaluation.
data_source: NetCDF input files; upstream provenance is not independently verified by the trainer.

source_manifest.source: Xiaoran Dong, Antarctic Sea Ice Prediction with A Convolutional Long Short-Term Memory Network
source_manifest.reuse_note: The archive supplies paper weights/design and the held-out SIC dataset, not the original 1989-2016 training archive or a ready inference service. The Southern Passage lag-regression experiment trains only on 2017-2020-08-06 and validates chronologically on 2020-08-07 through 2022-12-31; this is a new experiment, not a reproduction of the paper.

validation_masking: Finite SIC cells; static ocean mask applied when provided by the source NetCDF.
warning: Research baseline only. Not calibrated or approved for navigation or operational decisions.
